Driving innovation through research that matters

The Oromia Research Institute is at the forefront of scientific discovery and technological innovation, dedicated to addressing the unique challenges and opportunities in the Oromia region.

Our multidisciplinary approach combines traditional knowledge with cutting-edge science to create sustainable solutions that improve lives and protect our environment for future generations.

Our Mission

To conduct impactful research that drives sustainable development and improves livelihoods.

A prosperous, sustainable, and resilient Oromia region through scientific innovation.
